description: Use this when asking 'How much does a 30 by 40 pole barn cost?' or 'What would it cost to build a 40x60 pole barn and finish it to live in?'. Returns national construction ranges for the building only, with no published typical figure. Site work/slab/doors/height/permits are not priced. use=residential adds the separate living-space build-out band with an open top and a combined planning estimate. Includes an unpriced checklist, two separate unscaled reference cards and dated sources. Pure arithmetic, no network or model. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

length_ft.description: Required length in feet; footprint must be 100–10,000 sq ft.

use.description: shell: building only. residential: add the separate living-space build-out band.

width_ft.description: Required width in feet; footprint must be 100–10,000 sq ft.
